actions.reason: K8_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: RNA enrichment shows coordinated down-regulation of OXPHOS, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis, and protein secretion (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:76b61289b9), and WXS shows near-universal PBRM1 mutation with globally adjusted enrichment plus universal VHL (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:76b61289b9). Its set-versus-rest geometric alignment is near zero and modality-inconsistent (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:76b61289b9), which is direct counterevidence to independent membership; however, the structural screen shows no dominant internal subdivision signal and no feasible split separation (ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:76b61289b9), so no structural rescue is warranted, and no listed pair request remains that could change disposition. With identity positively supported and no available decision-changing evidence remaining, retention for downstream stability aggregation is appropriate.

K8_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: strong down-regulation of immune/interferon programs with up-regulation of OXPHOS and biosynthetic programs (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:6ae93549e8), and WXS shows globally adjusted VHL depletion with driver-panel TP53 enrichment (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:6ae93549e8). Its set-versus-rest alignment is consistently positive across all four modalities, though modest (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:6ae93549e8), providing positive membership representation. The structural screen shows no dominant internal subdivision and near-zero split silhouettes (ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:6ae93549e8), so no split is warranted; the K8_C0002-K8_C0003 pair boundary was already assessed and no further pair request remains available. Retention is supported.

K8_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: strong up-regulation of TNFA-NFKB, interferon, and UPR programs (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e66a4c0388). Its WXS driver-panel profile is comparatively weak, with no driver gene reaching adjusted significance and only a non-driver exploratory FLG signal (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:e66a4c0388), so mutation evidence does not add identity support; this is a limitation but not direct counterevidence to the RNA-defined identity. With identity supported and no remaining decision-changing evidence, retention is appropriate.
